# Mint v1.9.0 - Table of Contents

> Small and composable HTTP client.

## Pages

- [Architecture](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/architecture.md)
- [Decompression](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/decompression.md)

## Modules

- [Mint.HTTP](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/Mint.HTTP.md): Process-less HTTP connection data structure and functions.
- [Mint.HTTP1](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/Mint.HTTP1.md): Process-less HTTP/1.1 client connection.
- [Mint.HTTP2](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/Mint.HTTP2.md): Process-less HTTP/2 client connection.
- [Mint.Types](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/Mint.Types.md): HTTP-related types.

- Exceptions
  - [Mint.HTTPError](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/Mint.HTTPError.md): An HTTP error.
  - [Mint.TransportError](https://mint.hexdocs.pm/Mint.TransportError.md): Represents an error with the transport used by an HTTP connection.
